page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options and a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing the instance in the top 10% of its class. Multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores align with the average tier. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 vector extensions and hardware-accelerated cryptography, which contributes to its strong performance in encryption benchmarks, ranking in the top 25%. Memory performance is also strong, with PassMark memory scores in the top 25% and a cached read-only memory bandwidth of 2464.13 GB/sec.

The instance offers a high-compute, low-RAM ratio, making it highly cost-efficient for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe storage. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, requiring external storage attachment for persistent data. Given its dedicated CPU allocation, strong single-core execution, and cryptographic acceleration, the ecs.c8ae.8xlarge is well-suited for compute-intensive tasks, web serving, encryption-heavy workloads, and multi-threaded decompression processes.
